My Vevor Milling Table arrived approximately two weeks after ordering in September 2026, and I assembled it immediately. All the parts were included in the package. After thorough lubrication the screw threads and dovetails run well and are accurate after the fine adjustments are made with the easily accessible adjusting stoppers. The X and Y axis controls work well and the handles are a suitable size, neither too big or too small, but they do run a bit radially out of line with their shafts. This is not a problem as the handles have plenty of play and are not required to be run fast. The table fitted straight onto my pedestal drill's Z-adjustable table with the slots needing no adjustment. A smaller pedestal drill may have fitting problems. I milled a corrosion-damaged cast aluminium pump impeller case inlet thread flat with no trouble, and it has lots of potential for more work. I have not used it on steel yet. In summary, I am happy with the purchase, the delivery and the performance of the Mill Table, and it is a good addition to my home workshop. ‹NAMN›

Necessary tool to change the coolant on modern vehicles to eliminate air pockets. The Vevor tool was nicely made with metal parts (some others i have seen are mostly plastic). The air fitting used the standard north American fitting so no need to change it. There were no leaks and it pulled the proper vacuum on my auto. Multiple adapters should fit most cars. The vacuum held for several minutes showing no leaks on my auto, no leak on the adapter, and no leaks on the Vevor tool either. The suction hose easily pulled the antifreeze into the system and the throttle valve allowed easy control so you could refill the bucket as the coolant was drawn down. System has not needed topping up after several driving cycles so clearly most air was drawn out. Nice little tool - doesn't take up too much space, once you do coolant this way, you'll never do it the old way again.
